name: Siddon's Algorithm
definition: An algorithm that analytically computes the exact intersection lengths of a ray with each voxel in a 3D grid by tracking parametric alpha values at which the ray crosses parallel CT planes (x, y, z).
summary: Siddon's Algorithm analytically computes exact ray-voxel intersection lengths by sorting parametric plane crossings, ensuring precise line integrals unlike discrete voxel traversal methods.
